exceptions.event: GitHub exposes no completion signal a CLI can await; the CI verdict becomes observable only by re-reading the task-ci read
exceptions.reason: ha task ci --wait polls the same read on a 30s interval until a verdict, bounded by --timeout.

exceptions.event: A commit in the repository's writer process; that process exposes no commit notification to the fleet center's walsender.
exceptions.reason: PR #3619 smoke scan S1: the walsender re-reads the indexed replication head every 50 ms until a new commit, its keepalive interval, or the session's abort, replacing a spin that burned a core per idle edge. Delete when the writer publishes commits to the center. Coordinator-authorized entry, 2026-10-14.
